part.text:
The robot is at the end of the corridor, about 0.7 m in front of the green panel. I called rest, and it is now crouched with its motors off.

The route went about 3 m straight ahead, then right, then left along the final stretch to the panel. Along the way I turned into a short side branch by mistake, then went back to the main corridor.
